api: evaluate(kind, payload) -> JSON-compatible dict; pure stdlib, no imports of original bank or other author's implementation

payload: neural_b: rows x units; rows correspond to same condition/time after protected joins
pair_policy: unique_offdiagonal or full_ordered_with_diagonal; original policy is separately authenticated, never inferred
edges: {neural:list,muscle:list,kinematic:list,partition:list}, strictly increasing fixed normalized-distance bins
ordering_tie_policy: include_as_disagreement or exclude; original policy remains evidence gate
cycle_geometry.output: {pair_count, means:{neural,muscle,kinematic,partition}, histograms:{muscle,kinematic,partition}:{counts: rows y-neural bins x x-comparison bins,outside,total}, ordering:{muscle,kinematic,partition}:{draw_count,eligible,concordant,discordant,ties,neural_excluded,concordance:null if no eligible}}
cycle_geometry.formula: Neural/full-dimensional and partition Euclidean. Muscle Euclidean after supplied per-channel SD scaling. Phase shortest modular distance divided by supplied circular SD; velocity absolute difference divided by supplied SD; kinematic hypot of these two. Normalize each pair distance by its own all-pair mean before histograms and ordering differences. Original 10ms bins, 50ms muscle and150ms kinematic source-clock joins are validated by owner consumer. A/B neural partitions are matched; only partition A drives behavior comparisons. Original100000draws required by authentic module binding; tiny controls use fewer. Projections/variance source remain separately required documentary or independently checked outputs, not supplied by this primitive.

payload: unit_ids: unique original paired unit IDs
paired_test.output: {n,mean_difference,sample_sd,standard_error,t_statistic:null for zero SE,degrees_of_freedom,two_sided_p:null for undefined t,undefined_reason:null or string}
paired_test.formula: d=left-right; sample SD denominator n-1; SE=SD/sqrt(n); paired Student t mean/SE, df=n-1; two-sided p from Student t distribution. Preserve undefined zero-SE values; do not invent significance. Original exact pair membership is bound by owner aggregate consumer and historical dependence caveat retained.

payload: draws:list of finite numbers or null for undefined draw
draw_interval.output: {draw_count,undefined_count,interval:null if any undefined else [linear_interpolated_lower,upper],status:complete or undefined_draws}
draw_interval.formula: Sorted linear empirical quantiles at alpha/2 and1-alpha/2, index(n-1)*q. All undefined draws retained. Historical percentile convention not specified in source remains a gate, separate from this named prospective convention.

independence: Shared ABI describes inputs/formulas/output structure, not either implementation. Both new authors work independently. Old banks remain unchanged.

conventions.histogram: left-closed/right-open; final edge included; outside counts either out-of-range axis
conventions.neural_ordering: exclude abs(normalized difference)<=supplied threshold, hence exact neural ties excluded
conventions.behavior_ordering_ties: ties counted separately, not discordant; include_as_disagreement includes tie in eligible denominator; exclude removes it from eligible denominator
conventions.geometry_validity: matched nonempty A/B same row count and unit width; aligned behavior rows; reject any nonfinite intermediate or nonpositive pair mean
conventions.ordering_pairs: unique_offdiagonal requires different endpoints within each pair, either orientation allowed; full_ordered_with_diagonal permits same endpoint
conventions.interval: nonempty draw list; null draws are explicit undefined outcomes
conventions.policy_status: These named conventions implement explicit supplied policies; undisclosed historical bin-edge/tie/threshold/normalization policy remains unresolved.
conventions.paired_test_undefined_reason: zero_standard_error (canonical status code; after independent derivations, text-only interface alignment)
